zh: 未见此山时，此山与尔同归于寂。来见此山时，则此山一时明了起来。此心无外物，此色无色，此相无相，在灵台方寸间，即见真如。
en: Before you see this mountain, it rests with you in stillness. When you come to see it, the mountain becomes clear in an instant. Nothing lies outside this heart-mind. Colour is without colour; form is without form. Within the small chamber of the mind, suchness appears.
